title: SAVED
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s story you will hear that 
Jesus told Nicodemus 
that he had to be BORN again to be SAVED

Let’s meet NICODEMUS
Nicodemus lived in Jerusalem 
He was one of the Jewish leaders - a PHARISEE
The pharisees did not think that Jesus was the SAVIOR of the world
But NICODEMUS was different ……

Nicodemus came to talk to Jesus at night, probably because as a pharisee he wasn’t supposed to be talking to Jesus
He told Jesus that he could SEE that Jesus was from God because of all the miracles Jesus was doing (healing people and other miraculous thing like multiplying food etc)
BUT JESUS TOLD HIM THAT HE COULD NOT SEE HIS KINGDOM
Jesus told him that YOU HAVE TO BE BORN AGAIN to SEE GOD’S KINGDOM

This confused Nicodemus - he thought that he had to go back into his moms tummy!
But Jesus said NO 
You need to be born again by BELIEVING in Jesus
That will change your heart and you will be a new person
